description: This file manages plugin installation and registry operations for channel setup in the openclaw project, including plugin installation choices, registry reloading, and plugin source resolution.

methods.name: hasGitWorkspace
methods.description: Checks if a Git workspace exists in the given directory or current directory.

methods.name: resolveLocalPath
methods.description: Resolves the local path of a plugin entry if available and allowed.

methods.name: addPluginLoadPath
methods.description: Adds a plugin path to the configuration's plugin load paths.

methods.name: promptInstallChoice
methods.description: Prompts the user to choose how to install a plugin (npm, local, skip).

methods.name: resolveInstallDefaultChoice
methods.description: Determines the default installation choice based on configuration, plugin entry, and bundled source.

methods.name: ensureChannelSetupPluginInstalled
methods.description: Ensures a plugin for channel setup is installed, prompting user and handling fallback.

methods.name: reloadChannelSetupPluginRegistry
methods.description: Reloads the plugin registry for channel setup.

methods.name: loadChannelSetupPluginRegistry
methods.description: Loads the plugin registry with optional filtering and activation.

methods.name: resolveScopedChannelPluginId
methods.description: Resolves the plugin ID scoped to a channel, considering explicit ID or manifest.

methods.name: resolveUniqueManifestScopedChannelPluginId
methods.description: Resolves a unique plugin ID from the manifest registry for a channel.

methods.name: reloadChannelSetupPluginRegistryForChannel
methods.description: Reloads plugin registry for a specific channel, considering current active registry.

methods.name: loadChannelSetupPluginRegistrySnapshotForChannel
methods.description: Loads a snapshot of plugin registry for a channel without activation.
